title: Travel photo to surreal magazine cutout
summary: Turn an ordinary trip photo into a bold, surreal magazine-style cutout: you, cut out cleanly, on a flat colour page with one giant dreamlike detail.
why: An Instagram trend report covering October 17–24, 2026 names a ChatGPT workflow that turns ordinary travel photos into surreal editorial cutouts as the strongest AI tutorial of the week. Those posts show the finished pictures first, then the quick how-to.
steps: Pick a travel photo where you are clearly visible, head to toe if you can, with a landmark, beach or street behind you.
Paste the main prompt into ChatGPT or Gemini and attach the photo. Ask for a 4:5 portrait image.
Make two or three versions with different colours, then post them as a carousel.
For a Reel, show the finished pictures first, then a few seconds of your screen with the prompt.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Turn my travel photo into a surreal fashion magazine page. Cut me out cleanly, keeping my face, hair, outfit and pose exactly as they are, with a thin white paper border around me like a hand-cut sticker. Place me on a flat, bold background colour taken from the photo. Cut out one detail from the place I visited, like a building, a palm tree or a boat, and make it oversized and floating beside me, slightly out of scale. Add a soft drop shadow so the cutouts look like paper laid on the page. Keep it clean and minimal, with lots of empty space. Add a small, neat caption in the bottom corner with the city name and year. Vertical 4:5.

prompts.label: Variation: dreamy collage
prompts.text: Make a surreal collage from my travel photo. Cut me out with a clean white border and keep my face and clothes exactly the same. Put me on a soft pastel background. Around me, float a few cutout pieces of the trip at odd sizes: a giant coffee cup, a tiny version of the main landmark, a stamp-like ticket and a cloud. Some pieces overlap my shoulders like layered paper. Gentle shadows, matte paper texture, calm and playful. Vertical 4:5.

prompts.label: Variation: friends' trip
prompts.text: Use this photo of me and my friends (they've agreed to be in it). Cut each of us out with a white paper border and keep every face, outfit and pose exactly the same. Stand us in a row on a flat warm-coloured background, like a magazine cover. Behind us, place one huge cutout of the place we visited, cropped at the top of the page. Add soft shadows and a short caption with the place name and year. Clean, bright, editorial. Vertical 4:5.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: Turn this photo of our product (or our team at an outdoor event) into a surreal magazine-style page for [type of business]. Cut it out cleanly with a white paper border and keep it exactly as it is, including any labels. Place it on a flat background in our brand colour [colour]. Add one oversized cutout detail that hints at where it's made or used, like a mountain, a wheat stalk or a coffee bean, floating beside it. Soft shadows, lots of empty space, a small caption with our town name. Vertical 4:5.

tips: A photo with your full outfit visible and a simple pose gives the cleanest cutout.
If your face changes, add "do not change my face at all" and try again.
Pick the background colour from the trip itself, like the sea, a wall or a sunset.
Only use photos of people who agreed to be in it.
